title: Best Laptops for All-Day Battery Life (2026)
summary: 5 laptops that lasted 13 to nearly 36 hours in lab battery tests.
method: Picks come from PCWorld's hands-on laptop testing (updated Oct 2026). Specs and battery figures are for the configuration they tested; Amazon listings can differ, so check the exact configuration before buying. We don't show prices because they change daily. Battery numbers are from PCWorld's tests (mostly video playback) and real-world runtime will be shorter under heavy use.
assumptions: battery life was the main need; screen size and operating system were open.

products.name: Dell 14S
pros: Longest battery life PCWorld has recorded
cons: Performance is only so-so for the money
products.best_for: Anyone who hates carrying a charger.

products.name: Acer Swift 16 AI (Panther Lake)
pros: Excellent battery life for a 16-inch OLED
cons: Active pen doesn't work on the screen
products.best_for: Power users who also want 18-hour endurance.

products.name: Acer Swift 16 AI (Lunar Lake)
pros: Lasts a full day of classes
cons: A few keyboard keys are cramped

products.name: Microsoft Surface Pro
cons: Only ~2h at full brightness under heavy use
products.best_for: Email, docs and browsing away from a plug.

products.name: Apple MacBook Neo
pros: Feels premium for the price class
cons: The two USB-C ports differ in speed
Touch ID only on the higher-priced model
products.best_for: Everyday use on a Mac budget.
